scope: Noncommercial research: historical scores, executed audits, frozen retrospective controls and fresh supervised internal-family benchmark; no competition submission or external laboratory validation

claims.title: Historical public scores
claims.detail: Own pipeline 0.309; fusion 0.422 includes the external v4n solution. These are archived author logs, not a fresh leaderboard readback or final private scores.

claims.title: Source-library composition
claims.detail: Archived profile: 2,539,608 spectra and 275,810 structure keys. The new content audit rescanned the spectrum-row count; distinct-structure totals and library partitions were not recomputed.

claims.title: Same-library C1 exclusion
claims.detail: Complete same-library reference groups, including unsampled equivalent spectra, are excluded. The corrected path has now run on all 250 V-in molecules; historical leaderboard scores are unchanged and the isolated causal effect of this fix was not estimated.

claims.title: Fixed-grid simultaneous uncertainty
claims.detail: Paired bootstrap bands account for a predeclared novelty-mixture grid. Repeated model selection and domain shift remain outside that guarantee.

claims.title: Corrected-protocol retrospective revalidation
claims.detail: Completed Kaggle run with matching code/artifact hashes: all 250 V-in molecules, rebuilt full-source artifacts, verified fingerprints and fresh D2 index. Frozen v16 C1/C2/C3 MRR: 0.8324/0.6241/0.2374. Historical selection and incomplete original weight lineage limit interpretation.

claims.title: Exact train / public-example overlap
claims.detail: Executed on Kaggle: all 2,539,608 training rows scanned; 1,213/1,213 public spectra and 400/400 molecules have exact precursor, full m/z and intensity matches, also consistent in adduct/mode. Two coarse candidate pairs were rejected. This concerns public examples, not hidden evaluation.

claims.title: Molecule-paired spectral controls
claims.detail: Blank and intensity-shuffle treatments completed for all three models and novelty classes. Blank fragments reduce v16 C2 MRR by 0.4972, but improve simple-model C2 ranking. Controls expose dependence and failure modes; they do not certify generalization.

claims.title: Executed candidate-source quarantine
claims.detail: 1,710 mass-conflicting identities (3,891 provider rows) and 13 unparseable candidates quarantined. 1,071,863 structures fingerprint-verified; all 250 query molecules retained, including one with an absent standard truth key.

claims.title: Untouched external holdout
claims.detail: Fresh supervised fitting and sealed internal query-family validation are complete. Newly acquired external spectra and independent laboratory replication remain unmeasured; shared candidate/reference knowledge limits claims of wholly unseen chemistry.

claims.title: Fresh training and sealed internal query families
claims.detail: Completed source-matched Kaggle run: 600/150/250 training/development/test queries, two fresh fingerprint models and eight three-seed rankers, all 26 learned artifacts sealed before test features. Full C1/C2/C3 MRR 0.8665/0.8388/0.0373; primary C2 delta +0.6322 [0.5816, 0.6829]. Internal supervised query-family separation, not external validation.

claims.title: Refitted ablations and joint secondary controls
claims.detail: 27 prespecified contrasts share paired joint intervals. C2 D1/D2/D4/generator-feature removals reduce performance; D3 and NP-score effects remain unresolved. Blank/shuffle C2 deltas -0.5119/-0.0936. C3 truth coverage only 26/250.

claims.title: Hash-locked and installed scientific environment
claims.detail: Python 3.12 exact direct/transitive SHA-256 lock with 69 conditional entries; 50 installed Windows packages attested, compatible, and full-suite JUnit evidence recorded. Kaggle exports its separate exact package inventory.

claims.title: Candidate coverage and ranking loss accounting
claims.detail: Post hoc algebraic decomposition of the authenticated frozen internal test. C3: 224/250 truths absent, 24/26 covered truths in top 25, 6 rank first. Existing-list oracle ceiling 0.1040 MRR versus observed 0.0373. Conditional metrics retain explicit denominators; no new validation, causal gain or model promotion.

claims.title: Fail-closed numerical rank contracts
claims.detail: Summary and paired bootstrap reject noninteger, negative, out-of-top-25, nonfinite and malformed rank arrays before scoring. Fixed-seed valid results remain unchanged. Completed experiment source bundles remain frozen.

claims.title: Pinned MassBank external-source feasibility
claims.detail: Full 2,539,608-row training scan excludes all 491 eligible CC0 molecules by standard identity; zero novel molecules. Authenticated completed source. This does not establish external model accuracy.

claims.title: Two-library GNPS external-source feasibility
claims.detail: Full training scan leaves 7 novel molecules among 85 eligible identities; below the predeclared minimum of 30. No model performance was inspected. The isotope-safe second execution is the authenticated source.

claims.title: Legacy-preserving C3 candidate expansion
claims.detail: Opt-in 30-seed/900-proposal expansion includes both transform-pair orders and preserves historical proposals. Tests establish code invariants; real coverage improvement and external model performance remain unmeasured.

claims.title: Expanded GNPS original-snapshot novelty feasibility
claims.detail: Authenticated full-training scan leaves the same seven novel molecules among 936 eligible identities, below the declared minimum of 30. Expanded GNPS includes the earlier two-library source, so these stages are not independent replications.

claims.title: Separately registered family-purged external evaluation
claims.detail: A new free-CPU experiment removes selected external chemical families and identities from the entire training/reference corpus, rebuilds artifacts, fits fresh weights and seals all models before test. Original-snapshot novelty feasibility remains unsuccessful. Model performance and C3 coverage improvement are not yet established.
